rows.name: collectHomeObservation
rows.source: function collectHomeObservation(){const html=document.documentElement,cs=getComputedStyle(html),body=getComputedStyle(document.body);const surfaces=Object.fromEntries([["heading",".game-hero__copy h1"],["utility",".eyebrow"],["card",".portal-card"],["control",".button"],["shell",".shell"]].map(([key,q])=>{const e=document.querySelector(q);if(!e)throw Error("Missing representative surface "+q);const s=getComputedStyle(e),r=e.getBoundingClientRect();return[key,{font:s.fontFamily,padding:s.paddingTop,minHeight:s.minHeight,height:r.height,width:r.width,radius:s.borderTopLeftRadius,border:s.borderColor,transform:s.transform,shadow:s.boxShadow}]}));return{roles:{font:html.dataset.themeFont,density:html.dataset.themeDensity,shape:html.dataset.themeShape,state:html.dataset.themeState},family:document.body.dataset.pageFamily,bodyFont:body.fontFamily,heading:surfaces.heading,utility:surfaces.utility,card:surfaces.card,control:surfaces.control,shell:surfaces.shell,tokens:Object.fromEntries(["shell-gutter","card-padding","control-min-height","section-spacing","font-utility","media-radius"].map(k=>[k,cs.getPropertyValue("--role-"+k).trim()]))}}

rows.name: waitForNaturalRevealSettlement
rows.source: async function waitForNaturalRevealSettlement(){const element=document.querySelector(".game-hero__copy.reveal.reveal--1");if(!element)throw Error("Missing representative reveal ancestor");const initialStyle=getComputedStyle(element),before={animationName:initialStyle.animationName,animationDuration:initialStyle.animationDuration,animationDelay:initialStyle.animationDelay,animationTimingFunction:initialStyle.animationTimingFunction,animationFillMode:initialStyle.animationFillMode,animationPlayState:initialStyle.animationPlayState,animations:element.getAnimations().map(a=>({playState:a.playState,currentTime:a.currentTime})),transform:initialStyle.transform,opacity:initialStyle.opacity};const durations=initialStyle.animationDuration.split(",").map(v=>v.trim().endsWith("ms")?parseFloat(v):parseFloat(v)*1e3),delays=initialStyle.animationDelay.split(",").map(v=>v.trim().endsWith("ms")?parseFloat(v):parseFloat(v)*1e3);const limitMs=Math.max(...durations.map((d,i)=>d+(delays[i%delays.length]??0)+1e3),2e3),started=performance.now(),observations=[];let consecutive=0;while(performance.now()-started<=limitMs){await new Promise(resolve=>requestAnimationFrame(resolve));const style=getComputedStyle(element),animations=element.getAnimations().map(a=>({playState:a.playState,currentTime:a.currentTime})),identity=style.transform==="none"||new DOMMatrixReadOnly(style.transform).isIdentity;const settled=animations.every(a=>a.playState==="finished")&&identity&&style.opacity==="1";consecutive=settled?consecutive+1:0;observations.push({elapsedMs:performance.now()-started,transform:style.transform,opacity:style.opacity,animations,exactIdentity:identity,settled,consecutiveSettledFrames:consecutive});if(consecutive>=2)return{status:"PASS",selector:".game-hero__copy.reveal.reveal--1",before,limitMs,observations,naturallyFinished:true,intervention:false}}return{status:"BLOCKED",selector:".game-hero__copy.reveal.reveal--1",before,limitMs,observations,naturallyFinished:false,intervention:false}}

rows.name: collectControlGeometry
rows.source: async function collectControlGeometry(){const element=document.querySelector(".button");if(!element)throw Error("Missing representative .button");const samples=[];for(let i=0;i<16;i++){await new Promise(resolve=>requestAnimationFrame(resolve));const style=getComputedStyle(element),rect=element.getBoundingClientRect(),clientRect=element.getClientRects()[0],htmlStyle=getComputedStyle(document.documentElement),ancestors=[];for(let ancestor=element.parentElement;ancestor;ancestor=ancestor.parentElement){const s=getComputedStyle(ancestor);ancestors.push({tag:ancestor.tagName,className:ancestor.className,transform:s.transform,animations:ancestor.getAnimations().map(a=>({playState:a.playState,currentTime:a.currentTime})),zoom:s.getPropertyValue("zoom")})}samples.push({index:i,css:{roleControlMinHeight:htmlStyle.getPropertyValue("--role-control-min-height").trim(),minHeight:style.minHeight,height:style.height,boxSizing:style.boxSizing,paddingTop:style.paddingTop,paddingBottom:style.paddingBottom,borderTopWidth:style.borderTopWidth,borderBottomWidth:style.borderBottomWidth,lineHeight:style.lineHeight,fontSize:style.fontSize,transform:style.transform,zoom:style.getPropertyValue("zoom")},layout:{rect:{top:rect.top,bottom:rect.bottom,height:rect.height,width:rect.width},bottomMinusTop:rect.bottom-rect.top,clientHeight:element.clientHeight,offsetHeight:element.offsetHeight,scrollHeight:element.scrollHeight,clientTop:element.clientTop,clientRectHeight:clientRect?.height??null},scale:{devicePixelRatio:window.devicePixelRatio,innerWidth:window.innerWidth,innerHeight:window.innerHeight,visualViewport:window.visualViewport?{width:window.visualViewport.width,height:window.visualViewport.height,scale:window.visualViewport.scale}:null,documentElement:{clientWidth:document.documentElement.clientWidth,clientHeight:document.documentElement.clientHeight}},ancestors})}return{selector:".button",navigationCount:1,samples}}
